005package org.wpilib.tunable;
006
007import static org.wpilib.util.ErrorMessages.requireNonNullParam;
008
009import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
010import java.util.Map;
011import java.util.function.Consumer;
012
013/**
014 * The {@link Selectable} class is a useful tool for presenting a selection of options as a tunable.
015 *
016 * @param <V> The type of the values to be stored
017 */
018public final class Selectable<V> implements ComplexTunable {
019  /** The key for the default value. */
020  private static final String DEFAULT = "default";
021
022  /** The key for the selected option. */
023  private static final String SELECTED = "selected";
024
025  /** The key for the option array. */
026  private static final String OPTIONS = "options";
027
028  /** A map linking strings to the objects they represent. */
029  private final Map<String, V> m_map = new LinkedHashMap<>();
030
031  private final Tunable<String> m_defaultChoice =
032      Tunable.createConfig("", TunableConfig.of(TunableOption.IMMUTABLE));
033  private Consumer<V> m_listener;
034  private final Tunable<String[]> m_options =
035      Tunable.createConfig(new String[0], TunableConfig.of(TunableOption.IMMUTABLE));
036  private final Tunable<String> m_selected =
037      Tunable.createConfig(
038          "",
039          TunableConfig.of(
040              TunableOption.ROBUST,
041              TunableOption.onTune(
042                  () -> {
043                    if (m_listener != null) {
044                      V selected = getSelected();
045                      if (selected != null) {
046                        m_listener.accept(selected);
047                      }
048                    }
049                  })));
050
051  /** Constructs a selectable tunable. */
052  public Selectable() {}
053
054  /**
055   * Adds the given object to the list of options.
056   *
057   * @param name the name of the option
058   * @param object the option
059   */
060  public void add(String name, V object) {
061    m_map.put(name, object);
062    m_options.set(m_map.keySet().toArray(new String[0]));
063  }
064
065  /**
066   * Adds the given object to the list of options and marks it as the default.
067   *
068   * @param name the name of the option
069   * @param object the option
070   */
071  public void addDefault(String name, V object) {
072    add(name, object);
073    setDefault(name);
074  }
075
076  /**
077   * Removes the option with the given name. If the removed option is the default, the default is
078   * reset. Does not change the selected option; getSelected() will fall back to the default after
079   * this is called if the selected option name no longer matches an option.
080   *
081   * @param name the name of the option
082   */
083  public void remove(String name) {
084    requireNonNullParam(name, "name", "remove");
085    if (m_map.containsKey(name)) {
086      m_map.remove(name);
087      m_options.set(m_map.keySet().toArray(new String[0]));
088      if (name.equals(m_defaultChoice.get())) {
089        m_defaultChoice.set("");
090      }
091    }
092  }
093
094  /**
095   * Marks the given option as the default.
096   *
097   * @param name the name of the option
098   */
099  public void setDefault(String name) {
100    requireNonNullParam(name, "name", "setDefault");
101    m_defaultChoice.set(name);
102  }
103
104  /**
105   * Clears the list of options and resets the default. Does not change the selected option;
106   * getSelected() will return null after this is called until a new matching option or default is
107   * added.
108   */
109  public void clear() {
110    m_map.clear();
111    m_options.set(new String[0]);
112    m_defaultChoice.set("");
113  }
114
115  /**
116   * Returns the selected option. If there is none selected, it will return the default. If there is
117   * none or invalid option selected and no default, then it will return {@code null}.
118   *
119   * @return the option selected
120   */
121  public V getSelected() {
122    String selected = m_selected.get();
123    if (selected != null && !selected.isEmpty() && m_map.containsKey(selected)) {
124      return m_map.get(selected);
125    }
126    return m_map.get(m_defaultChoice.get());
127  }
128
129  /**
130   * Bind a listener that's called when the selected value changes. Only one listener can be bound.
131   * Calling this function will replace the previous listener.
132   *
133   * @param listener The function to call that accepts the new value
134   */
135  public void onChange(Consumer<V> listener) {
136    requireNonNullParam(listener, "listener", "onChange");
137    m_listener = listener;
138  }
139
140  @Override
141  public void publishTunable(TunableTable table) {
142    table.publish(DEFAULT, m_defaultChoice);
143    table.publish(OPTIONS, m_options);
144    table.publish(SELECTED, m_selected);
145  }
146
147  @Override
148  public String getTunableType() {
149    return "Selectable";
150  }
151}
